canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Nations Lending Corporation denied {value} of its 2,424 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Nations Lending Corporation decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Nations Lending Corporation will deny any specific future application with 11.1% probability
Nations Lending Corporation is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Nations Lending Corporation discriminates or violates law
11.1% applies to Nations Lending Corporation's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
